locations.description:
P-switch creates flower vaults and vine rails for you to follow up the mountain to the goal.

Skip the first vine rail; take the second vine rail to the top and land on the dinosaur.  On the dino, stay in the yellow or you'll likely slide off.

locations.title: Make a good use of Feathers to reach the goal!
locations.description:
Collect two ? boxes with feathers upon leaving the block.  Use one to get into the canon on top of the semi-truck (deploy as you reach fire barrels).  This will launch you to a platform with a rail.  One second after the end of the rail, use the other feather to ramp onto the platform with the goal.

To hit the second platform, stay centered when entering the barrel cannon.

locations.description:
**Location:** On the rooftop of Wario Stadium. The easiest way to get here is from the end of the [rooftop-path P-Switch](#loc=463487); you’ll be spit out on a halfpipe. Continue driving to the end and drop off. Turn around to find the P-Switch.

**Objective:** Collect all Blue Coins (10) in the time limit. The path is pretty straightforward., but the final Blue Coin requires a tricky grind on a large pipe.

**Time Limit:** 20 seconds

**Sticker Reward:** Wario Motors Pink Circle Sticker

**Time Limit:** 27 seconds

locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Pixel Spaceship Barrel

media.title: Question Mark Panel - DK Spacesport - Launch Pad Quarter Pipe

locations.title: Under the Rocket Platform
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** DK Rocketship Pixel Circle Sticker

**Location:** On the launch platform, in the northeastern corner of the rocket platform, next to some stairs up the structure around the rocket.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - DK Spacesport - Under the Rocket Platform

locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** DK Boosters Red Text

**Location:** On the second floor of the launch pad structure, on the end of a beam that goes under the DK Spaceport track.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - DK Spacesport - Launch Pad Beam

locations.title: Koopa Beach 1 Archipelago
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Koopa Festival Blue Circle

**Location:** On a small square of dry land where the Yoshi Diner is, in the archipelago replicating the Koopa Beach 1 track from the original Super Mario Kart.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Koopa Troopa Beach - Koopa Beach 1 Archipelago

locations.title: Quarter Pipe Warp Pipe
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Koopa Festival Pink Circle

**Location:** On an Eastern side of the main island, just Northeast of the quarterpipe with a [Peach Medallion](#loc=460595). It'll be right in front of a Warp Pipe that takes you up there.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Koopa Troopa Beach - Quarter Pipe Warp Pipe

locations.title: Stone Chicane Wall
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Lakitu Cave Paintings

**Location:** On the wall on the left-hand side of the chicanes before the start/finish line. You'll need to do a wall run in order to hit it, or drop down from the top of the wall.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Desert Hills - Stone Chicane Wall

locations.title: Lakeside Garage Rooftop
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Mario Bros. Circuit Blue Shield

**Location:** On top of the garage building on the eastern side of the lake. Get up on top using the green shipping container ramp, but be careful not to overshoot it!

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Mario Bros. Circuit - Lakeside Garage Rooftop

locations.title: Right of the Dry Bones Skull
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Pink Flower Papel Picado

**Location:** At the end of a ramp on the right-hand side of the giant Dry Bones Skull you get to from the first Glide Jump of the Dry Bones Burnout circuit.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Dry Bones Burnout - Right of the Dry Bones Skull

locations.title: First Turn Pergola
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Fish and Chips

**Location:** Under a pergola in a wooden area on the first turn of the Peach Beach circuit, close to a [Yoshi Diner](#loc=461589).

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Peach Beach - First Turn Pergola

locations.title: Starting Line Ramp
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Peach Crown Stained Glass

**Location:** At the end of a wooden ramp to the right of the Peach Beach starting line.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Peach Beach - Starting Line Ramp

locations.title: Opening Straight Side Jump
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Power Star Stained Window

**Location:** Between two wooden structures on the right-hand side of the opening straight.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Peach Beach - Opening Straight Side Jump

locations.title: Thin Rooftop Ramp
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Castle Blue

**Location:** On top of the eastern wall. To get here, go through the Warp Pipe at the end of the Yoshi Diner straight inside the castle to get onto the roof. Drive along the right-hand side of the rooftop to get onto a wire that takes you to this ? Panel.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Peach Beach - Thin Rooftop Ramp 1
Question Mark Panel - Peach Beach - Thin Rooftop Ramp 2

locations.title: Atop the Castle Wall
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Peach Silhouette

**Location:** On top of a castle wall overlooking the starting line fountain. You can reach this via a side area accessed on the second turn of the castle route.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Peach Beach - Atop the Castle Wall

locations.title: In A Parking Lot
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Vintage Star Sticker

**Location:** In the lower area under the starting line. Head for the parking lot in the Northeastern area to find it.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Peach Stadium - In the Parking Lot

locations.description:

**Location:** In the northern part of the lower area under the starting line. It'll be in a small tunnel running under the highway.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Peach Stadium - Under the Highway Straight

locations.description:

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Koopa Troopa Beach - Start Line Plaza

locations.title: Pit Garage Rooftop
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Mario Bros. Circuit Green

**Location:** On the roof of the pit garage close to the starting line. You can get up here using the lower-most grandstand grind rail around the last turn of the track.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Mario Bros. Circuit - Pit Garage Rooftop 2

locations.title: Roof of Luigi Tires
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Mario Bros. Circuit White Shield

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Mario Bros. Circuit - Roof of Luigi Tires 2

locations.description:

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Mario Bros. Circuit - Under the Penultimate Corner

locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Whistlestop Summit Train

**Location:** On the roof of the train station next to the start line. From the start line, make a left-hand U-turn through the station to drive up some stairs onto the balcony, which takes you onto the roof where the ? Panel is.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Whistletop Summit - Atop the Train Station

locations.title: Behind the Train Sheds
locations.description:

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Whistlestop Summit - Behind the Train Sheds

locations.title: Top of the Summit
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Sunshine Railway Sign

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Whistlestop Summit - Top of the Summit 2

locations.title: Secret Summit Jump
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Sunshine Railway Black

**Location:** Just before a Glide Jump, on a part of the secret summit road that's actually *below* the main racetrack that cuts through the mountain via a tunnel.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Whistlestop Summit - Secret Summit Jump 3

locations.description:

**Location:** Up the construction site next to the track's first turn. Use a blue Glide Ramp truck to get up here.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Crown City - Fire Flower Diner Rooftop

locations.title: Yoshi's Food Factory Wall

**Sticker Reward:** Delicatessen Super Delicious Hot Dogs

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Crown City - Yoshi's Food Factory Wall 2

locations.description:

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Crown City - Behind the Pier Sign

locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Crown City Blue Cityscape

**Location:** On the third floor of the parking lot.

**Location:** Inside an alleyway on the main street, a bit east from the starting line.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Crown City - In An Alleyway

locations.description:

**Location:** Between two rooftops of the Koopa Hotel, accessible from the southern road winding on the clifftop.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Crown City - Drink Refresh Rooftop

locations.title: Koopa Construction Sign
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Koopa Construction Cranes

**Location:** Located under a large Koopa Construction Sign. To get here, drove off the edge of the track after the solar panels.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Crown City - Koopa Construction

locations.description:

**Location:** On the corner rooftop, below the Seafood Restaurant sign. You can reach this by using the red grind rails just north of the corner.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Crown City - Seafood Restaurant

locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Sunshine Railway Spoke

**Location:** On a red roof located just past and to the right of the starting line. You'll have to drive around a P-Switch to get to it.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Whistlestop Summit - Start Line Red Roof

locations.title: Outcrop Warp Cannon
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Koopa Festival Blue Oval

**Location:** On a rocky outcropping over the track. Get to the top of the central island, then turn left and go off the wooden ramp to reach this. The outcropping will have a Warp Pipe Cannon on it as well.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Koopa Troopa Beach - Outcrop Warp Cannon

locations.title: Central Island Ramp
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Koopa Festival Blue Hexagon

**Location:** On a ramp leading up from the start line plaza to the top of the central island. You'll drive over it just as you transition onto the grass.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Koopa Troopa Beach - Central Island Ramp 2

locations.title: Island Under First Turn
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Racer Peach Stained Glass

**Location:** On a small island in the water area located directly under the first turn of the Peach Stadium circuit.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Peach Stadium - Island Under First Turn

locations.title: Roof of Peach Castle
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Princess Peach Stained Glass

**Location:** Found on the eastern rooftop of the main castle. You can get here by jumping off the left-hand side of the straight just before the last two turns of the Peach Stadium circuit.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Peach Stadium - Roof of Peach Castle

locations.title: West Moat Warp Pipe
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Royal Patisserie Cake

**Location:** Next to the Warp Pipe directly under the westbound bridge, down at the moat level.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Peach Stadium - West Moat Warp Pipe

locations.description:

**Location:** On the middle level of the stone walls on the outside of the first chicane turn.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Desert Hills - Chicane Wall Nook

locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Yoshi Cave Painting

**Location:** From the same stone walls as the [Chicane Wall Nook](#loc=461629) ? Panel, use the Glide Jump on the end of the highest wall to reach the roof of these ruins. The ? Panel will be on the far end of the roof.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Desert Hills - Wooden Ruins Walkway

locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Mario Enemies Hieroglyphs Color

**Location:** Sitting on top of the Start Line structure. To get here, continue down the route from the [Wooden Ruins Walkway](#loc=461630) ? Panel to reach a Boost Jump that'll get you on there.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Desert Hills - On Top of the Start Line

locations.title: Chicane Ruins Rooftop
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** W Vintage Sticker

**Location:** On a stone roof on the outside of the second-to-last turn of the Desert Hills circuit.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Desert Hills - Chicane Ruins Rooftop

locations.title: Fountain Plaza Sidewall
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Shy Guy Bazaar Text

**Location:** On a side wall just southwest of the fountain outside the castle.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Shy Guy Bazaar - Fountain Plaza Sidewall

locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Phanto Diamond Pattern

**Location:** On top of a walkway that goes over the Knockout Tour checkpoint for this region, close to the fountain plaza outside the castle. To get up here, you can grind on some ropes to the right of Shy Guy Bazaar's opening straight.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Shy Guy Bazaar - Kockout Tour Checkout 2

locations.title: Fountain Plaza Boost Jump
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Shy Guy Bazaar Vintage Poster

**Location:** On the end of a wooden walkway that ends with a Boost Jump that takes you over the fountain plaza just outside the castle.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Shy Guy Bazaar - Fountain Plaza Boost Jump

locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Turnip Tile

**Location:** At the base of the highest castle tower. To get here, drive into the castle from the fountain plaza and take the right-hand path. Once outside, turn right at the arches and then left around the corner and up the stairs. The ? Panel will be on the ramp on your left.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Shy Guy Bazaar - Main Castle Tower 2

locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Shy Guy Blocky

**Location:** On a rooftop overlooking the main Shy Guy Bazaar track, just after its last hairpin turn. To get here, take the stairs from the outside of the fountain turn, then turn right and grind on the red pipe, taking you across to a rooftop. Slide off the end, then grind rightways on a rope grind ahead to cross over to this ? Panel, between two Boost Jumps.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Shy Guy Bazaar - Bazaar Rooftop Jumps 1
Question Mark Panel - Shy Guy Bazaar - Bazaar Rooftop Jumps 3

locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Japanese Art 2 (Octopus)

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Cheep Cheep Falls - In the Pagoda 2
Question Mark Panel - Cheep Cheep Falls - In the Pagoda 3

locations.title: Under the Pagoda Bridge
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Cheep Cheep Taiyaki

**Location:** Under the red bridge with the pagoda on the western end. Check under the eastern end on the opposite side to find this ? Panel on a flat rock.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Cheep Cheep Falls - Under the Pagoda Bridge

locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Cheep Cheep Takoyaki Sign

**Location:** Up the side of a cliff wall in the elevated forest area. You'll need to perform a sideways Charge Jump to start Wall Running up the cliff in order to reach this. Remember that you can still turn while Wall Running to get more height!

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Cheep Cheep Falls - Side of a Forest Cliff 2

locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Apple Sign

**Location:** On top of a cliff overlooking the bridge pagoda. To get here, check for a Warp Pipe just west of this spot at the base of the cliff, which will take you up to where the ? Panel is on the tier below.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Cheep Cheep Falls - Top of a Forest Cliff 2
Question Mark Panel - Cheep Cheep Falls - Top of a Forest Cliff 3

locations.title: Across a River Log
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Japanese Art 6 (red symbol)

**Location:** On the far side of a fallen green log spanning over the river section of the track. To get to the log, fast travel to the Cheep Cheep Falls start line and turn right to the end of the peninsula that the river winds around.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Cheep Cheep Falls - Across a River Log 1
Question Mark Panel - Cheep Cheep Falls - Across a River Log 3

locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Super Mario Circuit

**Location:** On the lower rooftop of the main building next to the start line. Fast travel to the start line and use the Warp Pipe on your left to get there, then drive to the back part of the roof.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Mario Circuit - Start Line Lower Rooftop 1
Question Mark Panel - Mario Circuit - Start Line Lower Rooftop 2

locations.title: Start Line Upper Rooftop
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Pixel Mario Yellow

**Location:** On the highest rooftop of the main building next to the start line. To get up here, take one of the Warp Pipes at the base of the building, launch to the middle rooftop grind with a red spring panel, then jump off the raised section to land onto the highest rooftop.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Mario Circuit - Start Line Upper Rooftop 1
Question Mark Panel - Mario Circuit - Start Line Upper Rooftop 3

locations.title: Between the Pit Trucks
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Mario Circuit Green Circle 

**Location:** Between two red trucks on the north side of the central building.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Mario Circuit - Between the Pit Trucks

locations.description:

**Location:** On a raised patch of grass near the jump of the western "Mario Circuit 2" track. Get up here with a Charge Jump!

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Mario Circuit - Raised Mario Circuit 2 Patch

locations.title: Raised Mario Circuit 1 Patch
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Mario Circuit Blue Oval

**Location:** On the raised grass section in the middle of the eastern "Mario Circuit 1" track: get up there with a Charge Jump. It'll be on the north end near the winners podium.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Mario Circuit - Raised Mario Circuit 1 Patch

locations.title: First Turn Left-Hander

**Location:** After the first turn of the Acorn Heights circuit, take a left at the fork past the Yoshi's Food Truck to find this ? Panel.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Acorn Heights - First Turn Left-Hander 1
Question Mark Panel - Acorn Heights - First Turn Left-Hander 2

locations.description:

**Location:** On the grassy field that the valley turn with giant plants curves around. You can get here from the Glide Ramp with the [First Turn Left-Hander](#loc=462122) ? Panel on it.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Acorn Heights - Above the Plants Turn 1
Question Mark Panel - Acorn Heights - Above the Plants Turn 2

locations.title: Under the Giant Leaf
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Wiggler's Sightseeing Circle

**Location:** Found under the first giant leaf of the giant plant valley turn of the Acorn Heights circuit.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Acorn Heights - Under the Giant Leaf

locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Orange Blue Flower Sticker

**Location:** Underneath a giant tree root shortly before the Acorn Heights Starting line, albeit one not part of the track itself. Is close to a tunnel that goes through the root.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Acorn Heights - Under a Tree Root

locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Acorn Heights Green Sign

**Location:** On a leaf off of one of the tree roots behind the Acorn Heights start line. To get this, you'll have to grind on the vine barrier on the outside of the turn and then jump sideways to reach it.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Acorn Heights - Grind Rail Leaf

locations.title: Conveyor Building Rooftop
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Jacket Construction Sign

**Location:** On the orange roof of the Conveyor Belt section of the track. You can get here by driving right from the start line and going up the metal stairs.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Toad's Factory - Conveyor Building Rooftop

locations.title: Yoshi Snacks Wall
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Gloves Yellow Sign

**Location:** On a blue wall behind a Yoshi's Diner selling Yoshi Snacks. Instead of Wall Running, you can hit this by jumping off the curb of the grassy area below.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Toad's Factory - Yoshi Snacks Wall

locations.title: Behind the Muddy Bulldozer
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Mask Yellow Sign

**Location:** Behind the northeastern bulldozer on the muddy straight that ends the Toad's Factory circuit.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Toad's Factory - Behind the Muddy Bulldozer

locations.title: Below the Metal Dome
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Shoes Construction Gear Sign

**Location:** On the northern side of the lower walkway below the big metal dome with white "ITEM BOX" decals on it.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Toad's Factory - Below the Metal Dome

locations.title: Factory Rooftop
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Helmet Sign

**Location:** On top of the factory building close to the metal dome. It'll be at the highest point of the factory's rooftop, close to a walkway that goes back onto the metal dome.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Toad's Factory - Factory Rooftop

locations.title: Rocky Boost Ramps
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Japanese Maple Leaf Circle

**Location:** On the end of two Boost Ramps that are part of an elevated rocky area near the first two turns of the Dry Bones Burnout circuit.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Dry Bones Burnout - Rocky Boost Ramps 2

locations.title: Bony Grind Ramp
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Dry Bones Papel Picado

**Location:** From the [Rocky Boost Ramps](#loc=462236) ? Panel, drop off on the left side and go to the far left-hand side of the wide quarter pipe. Use the grind rail here to get to the end of a ramp with this ? Panel on it.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Dry Bones Burnout - Bony Grind Ramp 2
Question Mark Panel - Dry Bones Burnout - Bony Grind Ramp 3

locations.title: Cobblestone Food Truck Turn
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Dry Bones Sugar Skull

**Location:** After the second turn of the track, instead of going into the cave, jump left over the lava to a cobblestone turn with a Yoshi Food Truck on the outside of it. At the end of the turn will be this ? Panel, in front of a wooden jump.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Dry Bones Burnout - Cobblestone Food Truck Turn 1
Question Mark Panel - Dry Bones Burnout - Cobblestone Food Truck Turn 2

locations.title: Under the Glide Jumps
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Dry Bones Text

**Location:** Under the Glide Jumps at the end of the tunnel section of the Dry Bones Burnout circuit. To get there, use them to get to the giant Dry Bones Skull, then drop to the lower-most road and turn around to use another Glide Ramp.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Dry Bones Burnout - Under the Glide Jumps

locations.title: Outer Wall Ramp
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Flaming Bowser

**Location:** On a ramp of the outer wall, just counter-clockwise from the Bowser Castle start line.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Bowser's Castle - Outer Wall Ramp 1
Question Mark Panel - Bowser's Castle - Outer Wall Ramp 2

locations.title: Inside Spike Tower
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Meter

**Location:** Inside a tower in the opening lava dome area of the Bowser's Circle circuit. It'll be anti-clockwise from the start line, and is guarded by many Spike enemies throwing spiked balls onto the blue road.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Bowser's Castle - Inside Spike Tower

locations.title: Blue Road Overlook
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Bowser Motors Green Shield

**Location:** Use the ramp [inside Spike Tower](#loc=462248) to launch onto the central tower of the lava dome. There, make a right-hand U-turn to spot this on a ledge overlooking the blue road below.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Bowser's Castle - Blue Road Overlook

locations.title: Lava Dome Grind Rail
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Caution Thunderstorm

**Location:** On a small wall you pass by when grinding on the metal pipe at the very edge of the lava in the lava dome area.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Bowser's Castle - Lava Dome Grind Rail 2b

locations.title: Upper Rampart Warp Pipe
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Bowser Blueprint

**Location:** On an upper rampart on the edge of the lava dome area, which you can get up to using a Warp Pipe.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Bowser's Castle - Upper Rampart Warp Pipe 1
Question Mark Panel - Bowser's Castle - Upper Rampart Warp Pipe 2

locations.title: Room Above the Start Line
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Sidestepper Constellation

**Location:** In a secret room directly above the Stardew Peak starting line. To get here, drive down the Stardew Peak circuit until you get to the early turn that goes through the tower. Here, drop off the bottom edge of the turn to drop into the room with the ? Panel!

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Starview Peak - Room Above the Star Line

locations.title: Top of Stardew Peak
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Mushroom Constellation

**Location:** From the [Room Above the Start Line](#loc=462433) ? Panel, take the Warp Pipe on the northern end of the room to get to the top of Stardew Peak. The ? Panel will be directly ahead in the small room with the Lumas.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Starview Peak - Top of Stardew Peak 1
Question Mark Panel - Starview Peak - Top of Stardew Peak 2

locations.title: In the Library
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Shell Constellation

**Location:** In the library under the Stardew Peak start line. From the start line, drop down into the library and check the bench area directly underneath the track where the wooden benches are.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Starview Peak - In the Library

locations.title: Outside the Library
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Constellation Banana

**Location:** This ? Panel is located just outside the Library. From the Stardew Peak starting line, drop off the left-hand side to find this next to one of the columns holding the track up.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Starview Peak - Outside the Library

locations.title: Side of the Fountain Jump
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Fire Flower Constellation

**Location:** Found to the side of the jump that you take when leaving Starview Peak in a Knockout Tour event. From the starting line, drop down to the lower area and drive forward to the edge where the silver jump is. Turn right here to find the ? Panel.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Starview Peak - Side of the Fountain Jump

locations.title: Wall Under the Last Turn
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Blueprints Glove

**Location:** Located under the straight just before the final turn. If you're on top of it, you can drive off a gap in the wall of the corner to drop down. You'll find the ? Panel on the side wall, meaning you'll have to do a sideways Charged Jump in order to hit it.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Airship Fortress - Wall Under the Last Turn

locations.title: Top of the Spiral Tower
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Air Fortress Red Shield

**Location:** Located at the very top of the spiral tower from the end of the Airship Fortress circuit that you glide halfway into. While you can use a Charged Jump to Wall Ride into it, a simpler solution is to drop down from the top of the wall.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Airship Fortress - Top of the Spiral Tower

locations.title: Airship Lower Wall Run
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Airship Fortress Shield

**Location:** On a lower wall on the southeastern side of the airship. You can get here by dropping to the lower level of the track, then turning left once on board. You will need to Wall Run via a sideways Charge Jump in order to reach this.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Airship Fortress - Airship Lower Wall Run

locations.title: Airship Deck Wall
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Airship Fortress Text

**Location:** On a wall at the back side of the airship. It'll be on the starboard side (that is, right when facing the bow). You have to Wall Run to get it, which you can do by jumping off the top of the sloped part of the deck and onto the wall.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Airship Fortress - Airship Deck Wall

locations.title: Mast Platform
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Airship Fortress Red Outline

**Location:** To get this ? Panel, drive to the high section at the back of the ship with the Yoshi Food Truck. Face to the front of the ship and drift forward and jump off the end of the slope to reach a mast. The ? Panel will be behind this mast.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Airship Fortress - Mast Platform

locations.title: Behind the Start Line
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Comet Observatory Painting

**Location:** From the Boo Cinema start line, turn around and rive to the far end of the stone walkway on your right to find this ? panel near two boom arms.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Boo Cinema - Behind the Start Line

locations.title: Cinema Exit Room
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** King Boo Circle

**Location:** In the red room you arrive in after exiting the Boo Cinema theater room, turn right to drive onto the elevated area where this ? Panel is.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Boo Cinema - Cinema Exit Room

locations.title: Above the Auditorium Entrance
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Birdo Vintage Poster

**Location:** On the top of the entrance into the theater auditorium in Boo Cinema. You can get up here by going to the highest spot on the side walls and then driving inward to the middle.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Boo Cinema - Above the Auditorium Entrance

locations.title: Theater Balcony
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Wampire Vintage Poster

**Location:** To get here, locate the [Cinema Exit Room](#loc=462444) ? Panel, then drive to the exit to get to the upper level of the atrium seating. Head for the exit in the middle of this seating block, then veer for the right outdoor exit to find this ? Panel!

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Boo Cinema - Theater Balcony 1
Question Mark Panel - Boo Cinema - Theater Balcony 2

locations.title: Behind the Curtain
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Boo Castle Vintage Poster

**Location:** This devious ? Panel is in the theater auditorium, specifically on the wall to the left of the movie screen. To get here, use wooden slope in front of the stage to jump onto the wall and into a Wall Run, letting you grab the ? Panel!

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Boo Cinema - Behind the Curtain

locations.title: Muddy Start Line Platform
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Chargin' Chuck Monster Trucks Striped Circle

**Location:** From the Choco Mountain starting line, turn right and drive through the gap in the barrier to a square platform on the muddy slope, which will have the ? Panel on it.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Choco Mountain - Through the Mud

locations.title: Under the Jumbotron
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Choco Mountain Rectangle

**Location:** Around halfway into the track, you'll go off a massive jump with a blue ramp. On the left-hand wall is a Jumbotron with a ledge underneath: you'll need to use a Dash Mushroom or Drift Boost and jump off the blue ramp into a Wall Run in order to reach it.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Choco Mountain - Under the Jumbotron

locations.title: Right of the Fireworks Jumps
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Blue Spiky Tyre

**Location:** At the fireworks straight at the end of the track, after the first jump, veer right and drive under the scrolling sign until you get to the edge of the cliff. The ? Panel will be on your left on the slope.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Choco Mountain - Right of the Fireworks Jumps

locations.title: Behind the Fireworks Jumps
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Yoshi's Chocolate Bar

**Location:** In the fireworks jumps that end the track, go off the first jump and make a U-turn on the right hand side of the track to drive up to a Warp Pipe. Instead of taking it, veer left and drive up the hill to find the ? Panel.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Choco Mountain - Behind the Fireworks Jumps

locations.title: On a Metal Walkway
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** CCMT Orange Oval

**Location:** In the Fireworks Jumps at the end of the track, after the first jump, drive left off the edge of the cliff to drop down onto a metal walkway, with this ? Panel between the two stairs.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Choco Mountain - On a Metal Walkway

locations.title: Second Turn Sidepath
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Para-Biddybud Construction Red Circle

**Location:** From the start of the Dandelion Depths track, head for the second turn, but veer right to drive off the track through the archway. On the lower inside wall of the next turn will be this ? Panel: you can get it with either a Wall Run or by dropping down from the top of the wall.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Dandelion Depths - Second Turn Sidepath 1
Question Mark Panel - Dandelion Depths - Second Turn Sidepath 2

locations.title: Poolside Grassy Slope
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Notice Area Under Construction

**Location:** Close to the [Second Turn Offshoot](#loc=462453) ? Panel is a pool of water, with a grassy slope on the eastern side. This ? Panel will be on the grassy slope.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Dandelion Depths - Poolside Grassy Slope

locations.title: Under the Spiral Turn
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Boo Bread Basket

**Location:** This ? Panel is on a rocky wall directly underneath the second turn of the track, which is a spiral. To get here, from the [Poolside Grassy Slope](#loc=462454) ? Panel, drive up to the top and follow the grassy road, then drive off the side where the white barrier on the right is.

From there, follow the road turn past the P-Switch Challenge and Yoshi's Food Truck to get to the rock wall. You'll need to Charge Jump into a Wall Run to be able to hit it.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Dandelion Depths - Under the Spiral Turn 1
Question Mark Panel - Dandelion Depths - Under the Spiral Turn 2

locations.title: In the Water Caves
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Para-Biddybud Construction Text

**Location:** This ? Panel is located in the water caves. You'll want to go to the northeastern side of the cave (due left when entering here via the Dandelion Dephs track) to locate a curved ramp with both a Boost and Glide Jump on the end. The ? Panel is on this ramp.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Dandelion Depths - In the Water Caves

locations.title: Under the Final Turn
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Safety First Square

**Location:** On the Dandelion Depths circuit, take the split exit ramp out of the water caves with the Boost Pads on it. Stay on the left-hand side of this ramp so you can take the route that goes under the last turn of the circuit. Up ahead you'll spot this ? Panel on a curved, thin concrete ramp.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Dandelion Depths - Under the Final Turn

locations.title: Bridge Balcony
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Egg Green Square

**Location:** This ? Panel can be found right after you exit the huge indoor terrarium area and get to a broken bridge. Instead of jumping across the bridge, drop off the left-hand side of it and onto a metal balcony. Head to the end of this balcony to find the ? Panel.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Dino Dino Jungle - Bridge Balcony

locations.title: Dome Exterior Ramp
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Dinosaurs Charge Blue

**Location:** From the exit of the Dino Dino Jungle track's path through the giant dome, stop and then turn left to start going up the metal ramp. You'll come across the ? Panel on your way up.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Dino Dino Jungle - Dome Exterior Ramp

locations.title: Dome Exterior Wall Run
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Caution Dinosaur

**Location:** From the [Dome Exterior Ramp](#loc=462602) ? Panel, continue to the top of the ramp and then turn around. Up ahead will be a narrow curved area with a ramp on the left: jump off the ramp and wall run on the outer wall to hit this ? Panel.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Dino Dino Jungle - Dome Exterior Wall Run

locations.title: Dome Interior Wall Run
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Dino Dino Laboratory White

**Location:** This ? Panel is located in the upper level of the giant dome, which you can access via the ramp the [Dome Exterior Ramp](#loc=462602) ? Panel is on. In this upper level is a rock wall with this ? Panel on it: use the nearby metal road hump to jump onto the wall for a Wall Run and reach it.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Dino Dino Jungle - Dome Interior Wall Run

locations.title: Top of the Dome
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Dino Meat

**Location:** This ? Panel is at the very top of the dome. To get here, get to the upper level via the [Dome Exterior Ramp](#loc=462602) ? Panel ramp, then locate a geyser on the eastern side that gets you one level higher.

Near here is a Spring Pad you can use to to jump up to a red grind rail above, which then ramps to an even *higher* rail. This will get you up to the top of the dome: keep going around until you get to the rail that takes you across a broken ramp up to the very top: the ? Panel is on this ramp.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Dino Dino Jungle - Top of the Dome 2
Question Mark Panel - Dino Dino Jungle - Top of the Dome 3

locations.title: Next to the Final Jump
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** DK Pass Head

**Location:** From the big final jump of the DK Pass circuit, land and make a U-turn left and over the edge of the slope. Here you'll see the ? Panel at the top of another snowy jump.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - DK Pass - Next to the Final Jump

locations.title: Snowmen at the Final Jump
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Enjoy Skiing! Sign

**Location:** At the top of the final jump, stop and then turn right to go through the snow, between a rock wall and an orange netting barrier. Amongst some snowmen ahead will be this ? Panel.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - DK Pass - Snowmen at the Final Jump

locations.title: Mountain Cliff Wall Run
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** DK Pass Skiing Green Circle

**Location:** From the [Snowmen at the Final Jump](#loc=462607) ? Panel, continue away from the final jump and around a bend to a wooden jump into a canyon. This ? Panel will be up on the left-hand wall, which you can reach from the wooden ramp with a Wall Run.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - DK Pass - Mountain Cliff Wall Run

locations.title: Under the DK Pass Sign
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Mountain Minimal

**Location:** Found under the giant DK Pass sign. To get here, go to the last turn on the asphalt road section of the DK Pass circuit. Drive up the wooden structure on the inside of the turn to get under the sign, then check the left-hand side of the metal platform.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - DK Pass - Under the DK Pass Sign 1
Question Mark Panel - DK Pass - Under the DK Pass Sign 2

locations.title: Start Line Grandstand Roof
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Welcome! DK Pass

**Location:** On the roof of the grandstand on your left when you're on the starting line. To get up here, drive up the snow slope at the back of the grandstand.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - DK Pass - Start Line Grandstand Roof

locations.title: Outer Wooden Turn
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** DK Smoothie Bowl

**Location:** The second turn of the Faraway Oasis circuit is a curved wooden road. Instead of taking it, go past it and to the right to find a second curved wooden road going around a rock formation. The ? Panel will be on this wooden road.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Faraway Oasis - Outer Wooden Turn 1
Question Mark Panel - Faraway Oasis - Outer Wooden Turn 2

locations.title: On Top of Toad's Wharf
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Explorer Toad

**Location:** On the roof of the Toad's Wharf building at the starting line. You can get up here using a spring pad on the southeastern side of the building.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Faraway Oasis - On Top of Toad's Wharf

locations.title: Beneath the River Jump
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Explorer Toadette

**Location:** On the northeastern side of the large river that the Faraway Oasis circuit crosses over via a double "Pride Rock" jump. The ? Plate will be underneath the northeastern Pride Rock, near a Yoshi's Diner.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Faraway Oasis - Beneath the River Jump

locations.title: Yoshi's Diner Warp Pipe
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Toad's Wharf

**Location:** Near the Yoshi's Diner is a Warp Pipe at the base of the rock formation away from the river. Enter it to be taken to the top where the ? Panel is.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Faraway Oasis - Yoshi's Diner Warp Pipe 1
Question Mark Panel - Faraway Oasis - Yoshi's Diner Warp Pipe 2

locations.title: Riverside Buffalo Wall
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** The Adventures of Toad

**Location:** After the Faraway Oasis circuit's "Pride Rock" jump, you'll enter a river section. Before entering the tunnel, veer right and check the rock wall for this ? Panel. No fancy tricks here: you can get it just by bopping into the wall underneath!

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Faraway Oasis - Riverside Buffalo Wall

locations.title: First Turn Gold Blocks
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Question Block Rectangle

**Location:** On the outside of Great ? Block Ruins' first turn, drive through the middle of the left-hand column of Gold Blocks to find this ? Panel underneath.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Great Question Block Ruins - First Turn Gold Blocks

locations.title: First Jump Backwards
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Question Block Pattern

**Location:** After the first jump of Great Question Block Ruins, drive to the second jump, then turn around. Drive backwards around the turn and build up a drift boost. Aim for the right-hand side of the track and jump off to reach the top of the wall, where this ? Panel is.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Great Question Block Ruins - First Jump Backwards

locations.title: Second Turn Cloud Bounce
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Question Block Diamond

**Location:** At the second turn of the track, drive off the outside edge of the turn to bounce off a cloud and onto a floating island with a Yoshi Food Truck and this ? Panel on it.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Great Question Block Ruins - Second Turn Cloud Bounce

locations.title: Island Pipe Cannons
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Question Block Circle

**Location:** From the start line, turn around and drive off the left-hand corner of the track's end to land on an island. Use its Warp Pipe Cannon to be shot to a larger island with a Yoshi's Diner and P-Switch on it. Take the next Warp Pipe Cannon on your left to be shot to a third island with this ? Panel on it.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Great Question Block Ruins - Island Pipe Cannons 1
Question Mark Panel - Great Question Block Ruins - Island Pipe Cannons 3

locations.title: Backwards Final Turn
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Question Block Hieroglyph

**Location:** Go backwards down the final turn at speed and trick of the end. You'll land on a cloud that bounces you down to a small island with this ? Panel on it.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Great Question Block Ruins - Backwards Final Turn

locations.title: Start Line Barn
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Moo Moo Meadows Orange Stripe Circle

**Location:** Inside the barn on the right-hand side of the start line for Moo Moo Meadows circuit, between the start line and a Yoshi Diner.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Moo Moo Meadows - Start Line Barn

locations.title: In the Stables
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Moo Moo Meadows Blue Stripe Circle

**Location:** From the start line, drive to the stables on your left with the Moo Moo Meadows sign on top. Inside, check the haystacks alongside the stables' road.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Moo Moo Meadows - In the Stables

locations.title: Stables Dirt Field
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Moo Moo Dairy Cheese Ice Cream

**Location:** In a dirt field with a Yoshi Food Truck, just north of the [stables](#loc=462849).

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Moo Moo Meadows - Stables Dirt Field

locations.title: Stables Rooftop Fence Grind
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Cow Motorcycle Orange Circle

**Location:** On the roof of the stables. To get here, locate the grassy ledges north of the stables, then use them to grind and jump across two wooden fences. This gets you to a Boost Jump that gets you on the roof where this ? Panel is.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Moo Moo Meadows - Stables Rooftop Fence Grind

locations.title: Red Barn Rooftop
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Moo Moo Meadows Neon Circle

**Location:** At the first turn of the Moo Moo Meadows circuit two barns, one with a red rooftop and this ? Panel on it. To get it, look for a tree near the blue rooftop barn with a rope on it. Drive along the rope at speed to jump onto the blue rooftop, using its Boost Jump to get across to the red rooftop's ? Panel.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Moo Moo Meadows - Red Barn Rooftop

locations.title: Start Line Stairs
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Lagoon City

**Location:** Fast travel to Salty Salty Speedway, which takes you to a plaza to the *left* of the start line. Directly ahead are some stairs: drive up them and turn left to find this ? Panel.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Salty Salty Speedway - Start Line Stairs

locations.title: At the Lighthouse
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Huckit Crab Blue Circle

**Location:** Found on a rooftop of a store at the base of a lighthouse in the northeastern area of Lagoon City (aka Salty Salty Speedway).

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Salty Salty Speedway - At the Lighthouse

locations.title: Rooftop Lounge Chairs
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Neapolitan Pizza

**Location:** From the marketplace where the [At the Lighthouse](#loc=462854) ? Panel is, locate a wooden ramp that gets you up along the rooftops and into a grassy alley. Turn left to go uphill and overlooking a canal below. Cross over using a rope to get to the lounge chairs where this ? Panel is.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Salty Salty Speedway - Rooftop Lounge Chairs 1
Question Mark Panel - Salty Salty Speedway - Rooftop Lounge Chairs 2

locations.title: Through the Waterfall
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Welcome to Town

**Location:** After the first two turns of the Salty Salty Speedway circuit, turn right and travel down a wide canal. Keep an eye out on your left for a waterfall: drive through it to find this ? Panel in front of a Warp Pipe.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Salty Salty Speedway - Through the Waterfall 1
Question Mark Panel - Salty Salty Speedway - Through the Waterfall 2

locations.title: Town Hall Rooftops
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Cheep Cheep Blue Circle

**Location:** From the [Through the Waterfall](#loc=462856) ? Panel, take the Warp Pipe to be shot out the top of the town hall. Brake at the top, then turn right. In the distance you should see a line of slanted square rooftops that act as jumps: this ? Panel will be at the end of the farthest one.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Salty Salty Speedway - Town Hall Rooftops

locations.title: First Turn Ice Block
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Cherry Flavor

**Location:** At the first turn of the Sky-High Sundae circuit, stop and turn around to spot a yellow ramp flanked by a pink and yellow ice block on either side. This ? Panel is on top of the yellow ice block, and you can get there by grinding on the pink rail.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Sky-High Sundae - First Turn Ice Block

locations.title: First Turn Waffle Ramp
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Toadette Pink Ice Cream

**Location:** At the end of Sky-High Sundae's first turn, stop at the end of the pink grind rail in the middle. Here, make a U-turn to the right to go up a waffle ramp with this ? Panel on it.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Sky-High Sundae - First Turn Waffle Ramp

locations.title: Green Path Warp Pipe
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Toadette Luigi Ice Cream

**Location:** After the first turn, the Sky-High Sundae course splits into a pink side on the left and a green side on the right. Grind on the rail on the right-hand side of the green side and jump right to get into a Warp Pipe: it'll spit you out right onto this ? Panel.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Sky-High Sundae - Green Path Warp Pipe 1
Question Mark Panel - Sky-High Sundae - Green Path Warp Pipe 2

locations.title: Under the Start Line
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Sweet Melon

**Location:** To get this, fast travel to the Sky-High Sundae start line, drive slowly onto the grind rail on the right-hand side, then stop to drop off and fall down to the bottom. There, turn around to spot it on a mound with Warp Pipes: the ? Panel is on this mound.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Sky-High Sundae - Under the Start Line

locations.title: Split Path Side Path
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Spiny Gelato

**Location:** On the Sky-High Sundae circuit, when the Green and Pink splits come back together, make a U-turn on the left to go down a yellow walkway to an ice cream van. At the van, turn right to go onto a large yellow circle with this ? Panel on it.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Sky-High Sundae - Split Path Side Path

locations.title: Around the Stone Walls
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Ty-foo

**Location:** After the first Boost Jump of the Wario's Shipyard circuit, make a wide U-turn to the left to go around a stone wall. You'll come across a beach with a second wall on your right: go around the left-hand side of it to find this ? Panel in a dirt area overlooking the start line.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Wario's Galleon - Around the Stone Walls 1
Question Mark Panel - Wario's Galleon - Around the Stone Walls 2

locations.title: Start Line Tower
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Shish Kebab

**Location:** From the [Around the Stone Walls](#loc=462863) ? Panel, turn around and spot a giant stone ramp. Drive up it to find a tower, with this ? Panel inside of it.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Wario's Galleon - Start Line Tower 1
Question Mark Panel - Wario's Galleon - Start Line Tower 2

locations.title: Through the Window Rope
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Wario Shipyard Text

**Location:** From the location of the [Around the Stone Walls](#loc=462863) ? Panel, turn around to spot a curved stone ramp. The first window on the left side of this ramp will have a rope: grind to the far end of this rope to find this ? Plate.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Wario's Galleon - Through the Window Rope

locations.title: Under a Tower
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Wario Nose Diamond

**Location:** From the [Around the Stone Walls](#loc=462863) ? Panel, turn around and drive past a Yoshi Diner, through a doorway and on the other side of a wooden bridge. On the other side, turn right to find this ? Panel, well, under a tower.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Wario's Galleon - Under a Tower 1
Question Mark Panel - Wario's Galleon - Under a Tower 2

locations.title: Around Cannon Corner
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Wario Shipyard Vintage Poster

**Location:** To find this ? Panel, go through the Wario Shipyard circuit until you get to the cannon on the bow of a boat. Instead of going through the cannon as normal, make a right-hand U-Turn to find this ? Panel at the end of the deck.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Wario's Galleon - Around Cannon Corner

locations.title: Grrrol Billboard East
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Garlic Power Nose

**Location:** From the Wario Stadium start line, locate the huge metal ramp on the left-hand side that jumps over the opening straight. On the rooftop it gets you to, turn left and build up a lot of speed to jump off the dirt bump and hit the ? Panel on the corner of the Grrrol Metal billboard.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Wario Stadium - Grrrol Billboard East 1
Question Mark Panel - Wario Stadium - Grrrol Billboard East 2
Question Mark Panel - Wario Stadium - Grrrol Billboard East 2

locations.title: Grrrol Billboard West
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Garlic Power Pure Engine Oil White Oval

**Location:** On the second straight of Wario Stadium are two jumps, with a Grrrol Metal billboard between them on the right-hand side. The ? Panel is on it: to grab it, you'll need to grind on the arm of a nearby crane and jump off the end of it and turn rightwards in mid-air to hit the panel. To get enough speed, jump forward mid-grind to land for a speed boost.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Wario Stadium - Grrrol Billboard West

locations.title: Rooftop Halfpipe
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Stop Garlic Waste

**Location:** For this ? Panel, use [the huge start line jump](#loc=462872) to get onto a rooftop quarterpipe: turn to the side to land on the upper roof. From here, turn left and then wallrun on the side of a tower to land on a rooftop with three Warp Pipes (if you find this hard, you can jump across the back of this tower instead).

Take any of the three Warp Pipes to get onto a cable leading to the rooftop halfpipe with the ? Panel on it.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Wario Stadium - Rooftop Halfpipe 1
Question Mark Panel - Wario Stadium - Rooftop Halfpipe 2

locations.title: Red Rooftop Wallrun
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Garlic Power Pure Engine Oil Black Oval

**Location:** From the [U-Turn Rooftop](#loc=462876) ? Panel, make a U-turn around the concrete slope onto a red rooftop, eventually taking you to the ? Panel on the wall on your left. You'll have to use a Charge Jump to Wall Run up to it, but if that's too tricky, you can backtrack to the U-Turn Rooftop and grind along the red pipe to get on top of the roof, letting you drop down to get it!

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Wario Stadium - Red Rooftop Wallrun

locations.title: U-Turn Rooftop
locations.description:
**Sticker Reward:** Wario W Gears

**Location:** To get this, drive along the Wario Stadium circuit until you get to the end of the section with metal humps and drive under the giant W engine. Up ahead is a tunnel leading out, with a giant concrete U-turn above it. Drive up the left-hand side of this U-turn to find this ? Panel.

media.title: Question Mark Panel - Wario Stadium - U-Turn Rooftop

locations.title: Fish Bone
locations.description:
Swimming around the springs.

Abduct with the nearby [UFO](#loc=893027) to unlock as a playable character.

locations.title: Spike
locations.description:
Standing at the base of a cliff; following the rolling spike balls to find it.

Use the nearby [UFO](#loc=893028) to abduct and unlock it as a playable character.

locations.title: Pianta
locations.description:
On top of a blue sailboat.

Abduct it with the nearby [UFO](#loc=893875).

locations.title: Dolphin
locations.description:
Randomly found in groups, usually fairly far out at sea.

Abduct one or more with the nearby [UFO](#loc=893875).

locations.title: Cataquack
locations.description:
Patrolling along the beach.

Abduct it with the nearby [UFO](#loc=893875).

locations.title: Peepa
locations.description: Floating around a tree next to the [UFO](#loc=893026) you'll use to abduct it.

locations.title: Swoop
locations.description:
Flapping around in groups above the swamp.

Abduct with the nearby [UFO](#loc=893026).

locations.title: Conkdor
locations.description: Further up the mountain where you find the [UFO](#loc=893899). Once you hijack it, turn around to find them between two large rocks.

locations.title: Coin Coffer
locations.description: Running around near the [UFO](#loc=893931). Will try to flee, so be ready for a chase!

locations.title: Chargin' Chuck
locations.description:
Spawns here as a target to chase.

After hijacking the [UFO](#loc=893899), make a hard left turn - almost 180 degrees - until you see three cacti. Fly over them and continue in a mostly straight line over the road and [this P-switch](#loc=460717), staying low to the ground - when you're close, 'TARGET' will appear above his head.

locations.title: Rocky Wrench
locations.description:
The trickiest character to unlock. Fast travel to Peach Beach, then wait near the finish line to confirm that Rocky Wrench is one of the three NPCs racing the course - if hes not, fast travel to another track and back again.

If he is, hijack [this UFO](#loc=893875) and try to intercept his kart around the finish line.

locations.title: UFO
locations.description:
On a clifftop. To reach it:
- Fast travel to Starview Peak. Drive straight forward, then right to drop off the track.
- Follow the lower road past a P-switch and all the way along an icy road with angry clouds.
- Follow the right road past another [P-switch](#loc=463785). As it ramps down, look for a campsite to your right.
- Drive past this [Peach Medallion](#loc=475063) and along to the very end of the icy clifftop, where there's a stack of coins.
- Drop down one level to find the UFO between two trees in front of you.

**Can be used to unlock:**
- [Peepa](#loc=893892) - Circling a nearby tree.
- [Swoop](#loc=893894) - Flapping around the swamp below.

locations.title: UFO
locations.description:
On a clifftop. To reach it:
- Use the [Fast Travel - Bowser](#loc=461152)
- Turn around and drive in a straight line until you're off the metal wall
- Turn sharply to the right, turn around, and drive up onto the 'railing' of the metal wall
- Drop off onto the first cliff to your left, then continue forward and repeat this twice
- You'll find the UFO behind a magma rock, surrounded by crates.

**Can be used to unlock:**
- [Fish Bone](#loc=893029), swimming in the springs below.

locations.title: UFO
locations.description:
On a cliff near Spike. To reach it:
- From this [P-switch](#loc=460285), drive south-west along the cliffside.

If you press the switch, you'll see it in the background behind you when grabbing the final coin.

**Can be used to unlock:**
- [Spike](#loc=893630), spitting out spiky balls nearby.

locations.title: UFO
locations.description:
Underneath a castle wall, in the sea. To reach it:
- Fast travel to Peach Beach, and drive forward until you see a blue sailboat
- Turn left, drive down into the water, and towards the archway
- Drive underneath the walls; you'll find the UFO just around the corner.

**Can be used to unlock:**
- [Pianta](#loc=893878) - On top of the sailboat you passed.
- [Cataquack](#loc=893883) - On a beach to the North-West.
- [Dolphin](#loc=893880) - Spawns randomly in the nearby sea.
- [Rocky Wrench](#loc=893960) - Randomly spawns as an NPC racing the Peach Beach course. If he's not here, fast travel to another course and back.

locations.title: UFO
locations.description:
Halfway up a sandy mountain. To reach it:
- Fast travel to Mario Bros. Circuit, turn around, and drive through the tunnel. 
- Follow the road to the right, eventually driving through another tunnel. 
- Sharp turn to the right as you exit the tunnel; drive up a dirt pile, then another. 
- Keep driving up dirt piles; the UFO is on a layer to the left.

**Can be used to unlock:**
- [Conkdor](#loc=893900) - Turn around to find it between two large rocks further up the mountain.
- [Chargin' Chuck](#loc=893959) - See his pin for details

locations.title: UFO
locations.description:
At the end of a narrow cliff path. To reach it:
- Fast travel to Dry Bones Burnout. Drive forward, then right, turning left to go up some stairs.
- When the road splits, go right.
- When it splits again, go left, then left at the next split. You'll soon see a finish line.
- Hug the cliff wall on your left; you'll soon see some fences and torches. Bash through the fences to find the UFO among some trees.

**Can be used to unlock:**
- Any randomly spawned racers on the nearby roads.

locations.title: UFO
locations.description:
On a snowy clifftop. To reach it:
- Fast travel to DK Pass and drive forward, through the tunnel
- Continue forward, following the road as it curves and starts going downhill
- Bash through the barriers with yellow signs; start driving uphill, offroad.
- Hug the cliffs to your left and continue forward.
- Drop down one level to find the UFO next to a coin coffer and multiple snowmen.

**Can be used to unlock:**
- [Coin Coffer](#loc=893933), roaming right next to the UFO.

locations.title: UFO
locations.description:
On a tricky-to-reach clifftop. To reach it easily:
- Touch the [Hitch a ride to collect the airborne blue coins!](#loc=460702) P-switch, and enter the helicopter.
- Turn around and fly up towards the pale, round clifftop. 
- Circle around the second closest one to find this UFO - then pause and quit the challenge in a place where you can safely glide towards it.

**Can be used to unlock:**
- Any characters driving nearby
